guess-the-drawing.name: Guess the Drawing - Multiplayer Game
guess-the-drawing.description: Real-time multiplayer drawing game where players take turns drawing words while others guess. Built with Angular 18+ and Node.js with WebSocket technology for seamless real-time interaction.

architecture.description: Horizontally scalable architecture with stateless API servers and WebSocket servers. Redis handles session management and pub/sub for cross-server communication. PostgreSQL stores persistent data.

repositories.name: guess-drawing-frontend
repositories.description: Angular 18+ frontend with Canvas API for drawing, Socket.IO client for real-time updates

repositories.name: guess-drawing-backend
repositories.description: Node.js backend with Express REST API and Socket.IO WebSocket server

key_services.name: Game Service
key_services.description: Manages game rooms, player matching, turn rotation, word selection, scoring, and game state synchronization

key_services.name: Drawing Service
key_services.description: Handles canvas data streaming, drawing compression, broadcast to players, and optional replay functionality

key_services.name: User Service
key_services.description: User authentication (JWT), profile management, statistics tracking, and friend system

key_services.name: Chat Service
key_services.description: In-game chat, guess submission, profanity filtering, and rate limiting

infrastructure.deployment: Docker + Nginx reverse proxy with load balancing
